shared_inputs.detail: 1 formatting instruction ('make it polite: Confirm the 2:15 PM slot.') appears in both train and validation with DIFFERENT targets (two valid politeness paraphrases). Low risk: no identical pair leaks; slight optimism possible on this val row.

entity_annotations_vs_output_text.impact: Will depress word-overlap EPS scores by roughly 1% at most; does not indicate broken data
